At a Cabinet meeting Friday, President Trump rejected that explanation and blamed Minnesota's government for the attacks, without providing evidence. Galante speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

His comments come amid reports that President Donald Trump has ordered a fresh round of strikes that could begin as soon as this weekend, as the US and Israel reportedly consider targeting Iranian energy infrastructure. Miller says a limited bombing campaign is unlikely to change Tehran's calculations, while renewed escalation would make progress toward a Gaza ceasefire even less likely. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Microsoft’s US Taxes Drop, Revenue Jumps After Trump Cuts
title_cn: 特朗普削减开支后，微软美国税收下降，收入猛增
summary: Microsoft Corp. is the latest company to report a sharp drop in its current federal taxes despite growing US revenue, following the enactment of President Donald Trump’s sweeping tax law last year.

title: Trump Casts Doubt on New Iran Talks | Balance of Power: Early Edition 7/31/2026
title_cn: 特朗普对新的伊朗谈判表示怀疑权力平衡：早期版本 2026 年 7 月 31 日
summary:
On this edition, Joe and Kailey speak with:

Tyler Kendall, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent
Gen. Wesley Clark, Retired Four-Star General in the US Army, Served as Commander of US Southern Command, founder of Wesley K. Clark and Associates
Jeanne Sheehan Zaino, Democracy Visiting Fellow at Harvard Kennedy School's Ash Center and Bloomberg Politics Contributor & Leslie Shedd, President of Rising Communications and Republican Strategist
Spencer Kimball, Director of the Emerson College Polling Center (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness Hit by AI Selloff
title_cn: 利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 的态势感知受到人工智能抛售的打击
summary: Bloomberg's Hema Parmar details the massive selloff of AI assets from Situational Awareness, one of the world's biggest hedge funds and how Citadel's Ken Griffin stepped in to buy the investments. Parmar said that this move is part of Griffin's 'playbook' and he will often jump in to get a good deal when firms are in distress. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: New Poll Shows El-Sayed With Edge Over Stevens in Michigan Dem Primary
title_cn: 新民意调查显示，埃尔-赛义德在密歇根州民主党初选中领先史蒂文斯
summary: Spencer Kimball, director of the Emerson College Polling Center, said that Abdul El-Sayed has managed to keep an edge on Haley Stevens in Emerson's poll of the Michigan democratic primary for Senate because he has managed to put together a coalition of younger people and educated voters around the state. Kimball said that because Democrats are the party out of power, he suspects voters will rally around whichever candidate wins Tuesday's primary.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Push for 100 Years of B-52 Sees Delay, Costs Up, GAO Says
title_cn: 美国政府问责局表示，美国推动 B-52 研发 100 年的计划遭到推迟，成本上升
summary: A $21 billion Air Force effort managed by Boeing Co. to upgrade the engines, radar and communications of the iconic B-52 bomber is seeing cost growth and delays during early development, according to a congressionally mandated audit.

title: Brazil Party Blocks Senator From Becoming Bolsonaro Running Mate
title_cn: 巴西党阻止参议员成为博尔索纳罗竞选搭档
summary: An influential Brazilian political party blocked one of its key members from becoming Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate in October’s presidential election, dealing another blow to his chaotic campaign.

title: Trump Says He's Losing Confidence in Iranian Negotiators
title_cn: 特朗普称他对伊朗谈判代表失去信心
summary: "I’m losing faith in them because they do lie and do, they do misrepresent," President Donald Trump says during the meeting at the Camp David presidential retreat in Maryland. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Yet to Approve Any Midterm Spending From $401 Million PAC
title_cn: 特朗普尚未批准 4.01 亿美元 PAC 的任何中期支出
summary: Donald Trump has not signed off on a plan to spend any of the $401 million he’s amassed from political donors in November’s midterm elections, according to a Republican strategist familiar with the discussions, despite public assertions from his team that the president’s super PAC will provide a major boost to GOP candidates.
